before.headline: THE NEXT SIX
before.body: His Majesty’s Blood at D0nkey K0ng and El Niño at Slob on my Dobb pair four 6–4 contenders in the top-seed race. Red Leopards at Three Dreaded Snake and The Chili Cheesers at ObiWan Jacoby are bubble swings, with the 4–6 hosts needing to stop losing ground. The LLC visits Dr. Duckhook: recovery pressure for the visitor, top-seed contention for the host. Those are pressure games, not automatic eliminators. A loss to Seven Deadly Chins does eliminate Mud Dogs. Head-to-head can decide ties; three divisional rounds follow.
